batch: Exodus Block 1 - Bondage, Call & Deliverance (Ex 1:1-15:21), passages cast by scene / operation-web

units.characteristics: the multiplying people; the fearful king; affliction, bitter service
units.gist: NARRATIVE - Israel MULTIPLIED (ravah) and grew STRONG/VAST (atsom); a king who did not KNOW (yada) Joseph FEARS them as ENEMIES (sane), sets taskmasters to AFFLICT (anah) them; the more oppressed the more they MULTIPLY (ravah 1:12); RUTHLESS (perekh) hard (qasheh) SERVICE (avad/avodah), lives made BITTER (marar) - the interior of oppression and the fecundity that defies it

units.characteristics: the midwives who feared God above the king
units.gist: GEM - Pharaoh commands the midwives to kill the male infants at birth (chayah 'let her live'); 'but the midwives FEARED (yare 1:17) God and did not do as the king said'; God dealt WELL (yatav) with them; 'because the midwives FEARED (yare 1:21) God he gave them families' - the fear-of-God OVERRIDING the fear-of-the-king; civil defiance rooted in reverence

units.characteristics: the fine child hidden; the pity at the weeping baby; drawn out
units.gist: NARRATIVE - the child seen FINE/GOOD (tov 2:2), hidden; the sister KNOWS (yada) to watch; Pharaoh's daughter TOOK PITY (chamal 2:6) on the WEEPING (bakhah) baby; called (qara) a nurse; the child GREW (gadal), drawn out of the water (Moses) - compassion crossing the death-decree, the deliverer preserved

units.characteristics: Moses' violence and fear; the struggling Hebrews; flight and content dwelling
units.gist: NARRATIVE - grown Moses (gadal) sees the burdens, kills the Egyptian; two Hebrews STRUGGLING (natsah), the WICKED (rasha) one 'who made you JUDGE (shaphat)?'; Moses AFRAID (yare 2:14) - 'it is KNOWN (yada)'; Pharaoh SEEKS (baqash) to kill him, he FLEES; Midian, the well, the daughters; CONTENT/WILLING (yaal 2:21) to dwell - the deliverer's premature violence, fear, and exile

units.characteristics: God hears the groaning and remembers; the holy ground; the call; the name I AM
units.gist: GEM - the people CRIED (zaaq)/GROANED (anach) under SLAVERY (avodah); God HEARD (shama), REMEMBERED (zakhar) his COVENANT (berit), KNEW (yada 2:24-25); the burning bush; 'turn ASIDE (sur)'; HOLY (qodesh) ground; Moses AFRAID (yare 3:6) to look; 'I have SEEN the AFFLICTION (oni), HEARD (shama) their cry, KNOW (yada) their SUFFERINGS (makhov)'; the commission; 'I AM'; you shall SERVE (avad 3:12) God on this mountain; FAVOR (chen) and the plunder foretold

units.characteristics: will they believe? the signs; Moses' reluctance and God's kindled anger
units.gist: NARRATIVE - 'they will not BELIEVE (aman 4:1) me'; the three SIGNS (ot) - staff/serpent (chazaq 'caught'), leprous hand, water-to-blood - 'that they may BELIEVE (aman 4:5,8,9)'; Moses' reluctance ('not eloquent'); God's anger KINDLED (charah 4:14), Aaron GLAD (samach) in HEART (lev); 'I will teach you' - the reluctant deliverer and the signs given to faith

units.characteristics: the return; harden-heart foretold; the bridegroom of blood; the people believe and bow
units.gist: NARRATIVE - Moses returns in PEACE (shalom); 'I will HARDEN (chazaq 4:21) his HEART (lev)'; 'Israel is my firstborn... let him SERVE (avad 4:23) me'; the night attack, the BRIDEGROOM OF BLOOD (circumcision); Aaron MEETS (qara) him; the people HEARD (shama), BELIEVED (aman 4:31), that God had seen their AFFLICTION (oni), and BOWED - faith and worship kindled

units.characteristics: first confrontation; who is the LORD that I should obey? the increased burden; the officers' despair
units.gist: NARRATIVE - 'who is the LORD that I should OBEY (shama 5:2)? I do not KNOW (yada) him'; Pharaoh calls them IDLE (raphah), lays heavier WORK (avodah) - bricks without straw, the LYING (sheqer) accusation; the beaten officers cry, blame Moses ('made us STINK (baash 5:21), the LORD JUDGE (shaphat)'); Moses to God - 'why have you done EVIL (raa 5:22-23)?' - defiance above, despair below, the deliverer doubting

units.characteristics: I AM the LORD; the covenant remembered; I will redeem; the people would not listen
units.gist: NARRATIVE - 'I AM the LORD'; the COVENANT (berit 6:4-5) REMEMBERED (zakhar), the GROANING heard; 'I will bring you out from under the SLAVERY (avodah), REDEEM you with JUDGMENTS (shephet 6:6), take you as my people, GIVE (natan) the land'; but the people would not LISTEN (shama 6:9) for HARSH (qasheh) SLAVERY and broken spirit; the recommission ('made you like God to Pharaoh' 7:1) - the redemption-name against despair. [6:14-27 genealogy - thin, lifespans (chayyim) only]

units.characteristics: the staff-serpent sign; the hardened heart begins; the Nile to blood
units.gist: NARRATIVE - the staff-serpent before Pharaoh, the WISE MEN (chakham 7:11) SUMMONED (qara), the swallowing; the HEART (lev) HARDENED (chazaq 7:13); the Nile struck to blood, the fish die, the river STINKS (baash 7:18,21), Egypt cannot drink; the magicians match it; the HEART (lev) HARDENED (chazaq 7:22) - the first plague and the heart that will not turn

units.characteristics: frogs and gnats; Pharaoh pleads then hardens; the finger of God
units.gist: NARRATIVE - frogs; Pharaoh PLEADS (atar 8:8) 'entreat the LORD to TAKE AWAY (sur)'; the relief, then the HEART (lev) HARDENED/HEAVY (kaved 8:15); gnats, the magicians fail - 'the finger of God'; the HEART (lev) HARDENED (chazaq 8:19) - the plea under pressure and the hardening once relieved

units.characteristics: flies, livestock, boils; the distinction of Goshen; the deceitful plea; the heart heavy
units.gist: NARRATIVE - flies, but Goshen set apart (a SIGN/ot 8:23); Pharaoh's deceitful PLEAD (atar 8:28-30), then HEART (lev) HARDENED/HEAVY (kaved 8:32); the livestock die (chazaq 'hold fast' 9:2), the HEART (lev) HEAVY (kaved 9:7); the boils - the magicians cannot stand; the HEART (lev) HARDENED (chazaq 9:12) - the distinction of God's people, the bargaining and the hardening

units.characteristics: the hail; that you may know none like me; those who feared the word; I have sinned
units.gist: GEM - the hail warned, 'that you may KNOW (yada) there is none like me in all the earth'; those who FEARED (yare 9:20) the word of the LORD brought their servants in; the hail; Pharaoh 'I have SINNED (chata 9:27), the LORD is RIGHTEOUS (tsaddiq), I and my people WICKED (rasha)'; PLEADS (atar 9:28); Moses knows he does not yet FEAR (yare 9:30) God; the HEART (lev) HARDENED (kaved/chazaq 9:34-35), sinning again - the confession that is not repentance

units.characteristics: locusts and darkness; how long will you refuse to humble yourself; the heart hardened by God
units.gist: NARRATIVE - 'I have HARDENED (kaved 10:1) his HEART (lev)... that you may tell your children'; 'how long will you refuse to HUMBLE (anah 10:3) yourself?'; the locusts; Pharaoh 'I have SINNED (chata 10:16)', PLEADS (atar) 'remove (sur) this death'; the HEART (lev) HARDENED (chazaq 10:20); the darkness felt; the bargaining over the flocks; the HEART (lev) HARDENED (chazaq 10:27) - the refusal to be humbled, the heart God hardens

units.characteristics: the final warning; favor in Egypt's eyes; the heart hardened to the last
units.gist: NARRATIVE - the last plague foretold; the people find FAVOR (chen 11:3), Egyptians GIVE (natan); Moses goes out in HOT (chori 'burning') anger; 'my WONDERS (ravah 'be multiplied' 11:9) may be multiplied'; the HEART (lev) HARDENED (chazaq 11:10) to the last - the threshold of the final blow

units.characteristics: the Passover lamb; the blood; the memorial to keep; teaching the children
units.gist: NARRATIVE/ORDINANCE - the lamb UNBLEMISHED (tamim 12:5), the blood on the doorposts; the DESTROYER (mashchit 12:13; shachat 12:23) passing over; a HOLY (qodesh 12:16) ASSEMBLY (miqra); OBSERVE/KEEP (shamar 12:17,24,25) this SERVICE (avodah); 'when your children ask, what is this SERVICE (avodah 12:26)?' - the sheltering blood and the memory to be kept and taught

units.characteristics: the death of the firstborn; the driving out; the plunder of Egypt
units.gist: NARRATIVE - at midnight the firstborn die; Pharaoh SUMMONS (qara 12:31) 'go, SERVE (avad) the LORD'; Egypt URGENT (chazaq 12:33) to send them; the people ASKED (shaal 12:35-36) silver and gold, God gave them FAVOR (chen), and they PLUNDERED Egypt (natan 'given'); the exodus by night, the mixed multitude - the death that frees, the spoil of the oppressor. [12:43-51 Passover ordinance - thin tail]

units.characteristics: consecrate the firstborn; remember this day; redeem; the strong hand
units.gist: NARRATIVE/ORDINANCE - 'CONSECRATE (qadash 13:2) to me every firstborn'; 'REMEMBER (zakhar 13:3) this day, the LORD brought you out by a STRONG (chozeq) hand'; KEEP (shamar 13:10) the SERVICE (avodah); REDEEM (padah 13:13,15) the firstborn; 'when your child ASKS (shaal 13:14)'; the STRONG (chozeq 13:14,16) hand as a sign on hand and forehead - memory and redemption bound to the body

units.characteristics: the pillar; the pursuit; fear then faith; stand still, the LORD will fight; the crossing
units.gist: THE DELIVERANCE - not led by the Philistine way lest they RELENT (nacham 13:17) and return; the pillar of cloud/fire; God HARDENS (chazaq 14:4,8,17) Pharaoh's HEART (lev), the HOST (chayil) pursues; the people FEAR (yare 14:10), murmur 'better to SERVE (avad 14:12) Egypt'; 'FEAR not (yare 14:13), stand firm... the LORD will fight, be SILENT (charesh 14:14)'; LIFT (rum) the staff, the sea splits; the crossing, the Egyptians drowned; Israel FEARED (yare 14:31) the LORD and BELIEVED (aman) - terror turned to faith at the sea

units.characteristics: the song of triumph; the divine warrior; steadfast love; the nations' terror; Miriam
units.gist: GEM/SONG - 'I will sing... he has TRIUMPHED (gaah 15:1) gloriously'; the LORD my STRENGTH (oz)/SONG (zimrat), I will EXALT (rum) him; the enemy's DESIRE (nephesh 'appetite' 15:9) to destroy; 'who is like you, majestic in HOLINESS (qodesh), AWESOME (yare 15:11) in PRAISES (tehillah), doing WONDERS (pele)'; STEADFAST LOVE (chesed 15:13) leading the redeemed; the nations TREMBLE (ragaz/raad/bahal), TERROR (emah) and DREAD (pachad 15:16) fall, they are STILL (damam) as stone; Miriam's answering song (gaah 15:21) - worship as the interior's response to deliverance
